headline: AEON Credit says its system was accessed without authorization after its card portal and app were down for more than 40 hours.
summary: First draft. 5 sources (1 Tier 1, 3 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 9 claims, 5 questions. AEON's own website notice confirms unauthorized access; RTHK and The Standard report it independently. The company has not tied it to the outage or said what data was reached. No Hong Kong regulator statement found. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
